title: My first project
author: RoyInProgress
selftext:
Hi all,

I’m new to this sub, so not sure what is common but wanted to share something I’ve been working on.

I’m not a game developer, engineer or designer. I just like gaming and creating cool stuff, experimenting with AI right now to see what’s possible.

My wife made some designs and backstory for a Japanese fantasy world, starring our sons and dog.  
Based on her world, I made a first splice of this 2D game using Godot.

Probably not impressive to many, but I’m very happy and impressed with what we’ve cooked up so far - so wanted to share it 😄

If you have any feedback or questions, I’m happy to hear it!

replies.author: Stinky_You
replies.body: Practice on free ai. Still so much idk. Wife just added me to her account and I started wasting usage right away haha it's been fun

comments.author: NearbyChampionship90
comments.body: how much would you say it cost you so far to make this game concept?

replies.author: RoyInProgress
replies.body:
Well in a way it didn’t cost me anything, because I just used the tokens I have from those subscriptions.

But I’ve been working on the game for a week, so that would about $10-15 😉
